subject: english-literature
title: Love, Fate and Conflict
welcome_lead: Three giant themes hold the tragedy together.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on themes and ending of Romeo & Juliet.
final_note: You can now name R&J's core themes and ending.

concepts.def: Romeo's witty friend, killed by Tybalt.

walkthroughs.body_html: R&J explores love (between Romeo and Juliet), fate (the stars) and conflict (the feud, duels). Use all three when writing about it.
Friar Lawrence secretly marries the lovers and plans the fake death. Mercutio's death in Act 3 triggers the spiralling tragedy.
The play ends with a double suicide in the Capulet tomb: Romeo poisons himself, Juliet stabs herself — the families finally make peace.
